Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 10528 of 2023
Applicant :- Lakhan Taumar

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Saroj Kumar Tiwari
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri R.M. Yadav, learned A.G.A. for the State and also perused the record.

2. The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in F.I.R./Case Crime No. 262 of 2023, under Sections 506 IPC and 67-A Information Technology (Amendment)
Act, 2008 (as well as added Section 376 IPC and 66 I.T. Act according to Parcha No. 7 of the Case Diary, Police Station Dehli Gate, District Aligarh, with a prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail.

3. As per prosecution story, the informant is stated to have instituted an FIR against the applicant prior to the institution of the present case, as such, on 28.6.2023, the applicant is stated to have threatened her to take her life and on 3.7.2023, he is stated to have posted fake videos of her to her relatives and had even threatened her on telephone several times.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that the applicant is maliciously being prosecuted in the present case due to ulterior motive and has the apprehension of his arrest.
The applicant has nothing to do with the said offence as alleged by the prosecution.
It is next stated that the case is triable by Magistrate, and the applicant has been put to double jeopardy, as there is already an FIR instituted against him.
There is no evidence against him, as no video has been collected by the investigating officer.
It is next stated that there is no previous criminal history of the applicant as the matter between the two had already been settled.
Learned counsel has next stated that the FIR is delayed by about twelve days and there is no explanation of the said delay caused.
5. Several other submissions have been made on behalf of the applicant to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against him.
The circumstances which, as per counsel, led to the false implication of the applicant have also been touched upon at length.
In case, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed, he will not misuse the liberty and shall cooperate with trial.
6. On the other hand, learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail but unable to dispute the submissions raised by the learned counsel for the applicant.

7. On due consideration to the arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and in view of the law laid down by the Apex Court in the case of "Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC online SC 98", the applicant is entitled to be granted anticipatory bail in this case.

sentences.text: 8. Without expressing any opinion upon ultimate merits of the case either ways which may adversely affect the trial of the case, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.
